Toxic chronic tubulointerstitial kidney damage; associated urothelial cancer is a separate disease.
Advanced cataract directly impairs the ocular lens.
Acute allergic conjunctival inflammation defines this immune-mediated eye disease.
Brain and skin lesions define TSC2 disease; renal angiomyolipomas ~50%, cysts ~44%, cardiac rhabdomyomas ~50%. Oral and ocular diagnostic lesions omitted at cap.
Isolated sperm flagellar defects and male infertility affect reproductive function without established endocrine disease.
Frontotemporal and motor neuron degeneration; muscle wasting reflects denervation rather than intrinsic muscle disease.
Diffuse alveolar injury and increased pulmonary permeability cause acute respiratory failure.
Persistent glomerular protein leakage defines renal disease; steroid resistance does not establish an immune mechanism across the group.
Spastic paraplegia and microcephaly define neurologic disease; optic atrophy defines ocular disease. Sex reversal alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction.
Lysosomal cystine storage with defining kidney and eye injury; myopathy reported in 80-99%. Hepatosplenomegaly alone does not establish functional damage.
Familial cortical myoclonic tremor and epilepsy constitute neurologic disease.
Alpha-globin deficiency causes mild microcytic anemia; no common direct extrahematologic damage is established.
Squamous carcinoma originates in the urinary tract, which belongs to the renal axis.
Joubert neurodevelopmental disease; ptosis/strabismus and hand polydactyly each occur in 4/4 patients. Hearing impairment in 1/4 is below threshold.
Defective ocular focusing directly impairs vision.
Defining hair, cholestatic liver and neurodevelopmental disease; hip dysplasia 3/3 and limb deformities common. Ocular, GI, airway and cardiac findings omitted at cap.
Goniodysgenesis defines an ocular developmental defect and intellectual disability defines neurologic involvement; short stature alone adds no axis.
Myocardial infarction directly damages heart muscle despite absent clinical symptoms.
Childhood osteosarcoma arises predominantly in bone; metastatic sites are not defining organ involvement.
Herniation of the stomach defines a gastrointestinal structural disorder.
Disease of the gingiva; gums and oral mucosa belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Serine biosynthesis deficiency with defining microcephaly, developmental impairment and seizures. Feeding difficulty is symptomatic; ichthyosis is occasional.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and brain abnormalities define disease; strabismus occurs in 5/9 (~56%). Feeding difficulty and hypotonia alone add no organ.
Idiopathic psychiatric catatonia; psychomotor signs and catatonic unresponsiveness do not establish a separate neurologic organ disorder.
